text:
This run cannot put either hiring plan forward: the **£400k annual-salary constraint was not assessed**, and the comparison is fragile.

- The model’s ordering can change with small assumption changes; platform delivery capacity is the most sensitive assumption, and it is an Olumi estimate rather than user-supplied evidence.
- Every material input behind the comparison is machine-authored or unattributed, and the model assumes that a higher goal value means better delivery performance.
- The salary limit remains recorded but could not be matched to the model’s calculated salary-spend scale, so neither plan has been shown to satisfy it.

Clarifying what the £400k cap measures would make the next run materially more decision-relevant.
